definitions.explanation: A cooking method where ingredients are deep-fried directly in oil without any flour, breadcrumbs, or batter. Used as a suru verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{素揚|すあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To deep-fry the vegetables without batter.

examples.japanese: {茄子|なす}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素揚|すあ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Deep-fried eggplant without batter goes well with curry.

examples.japanese: {素揚|すあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Deep-frying without batter lets you enjoy the natural flavor of the ingredients.

notes:
USAGE:
A cooking term commonly found in recipes. The {素|す} prefix means "plain" or "without additions," contrasting with ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧ (tempura, battered and fried) or ⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧ (coated with starch or flour). Commonly used for vegetables like {茄子|なす} (eggplant), ⟦{蓮根|れんこん}→蓮根：13994_renkon⟧ (lotus root), and {南瓜|かぼちゃ} (pumpkin).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {素揚|すあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to deep-fry without coating)
- {素揚|すあ}げ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (vegetables fried without batter)
- {素揚|すあ}げにして⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (to deep-fry plain and eat with salt)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: tempura — battered and deep-fried
- ⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧: deep-fried with starch coating — typically for chicken
